svg.text: onto the clock of A, one word
of each channel at a time;
one sets the rate, samples of
sample_slots_select of A: the sample size from its DEVICE_CODE (20 bit with 16/14 bit builds)
Example 1: 16-bit samples on the 32-bit bus, both channels
Builds: ENABLE_20BIT=1 with ENABLE_16BIT=1, or NUM_LANES=2 with ENABLE_14BIT=1 and ENABLE_16BIT=1; the converters set to 16 bits
Example 2: 20-bit samples, each sign extended to 32 bits, both channels
Builds: ENABLE_20BIT=1, alone or with ENABLE_16BIT/ENABLE_14BIT; the converters set to 20 bits
Example 3: 16-bit samples on the 32-bit bus, only channel A
Builds: ENABLE_20BIT=1 with ENABLE_16BIT=1, or NUM_LANES=2 with ENABLE_14BIT=1 and ENABLE_16BIT=1; the converters set to 16 bits
Words are drawn as columns, the earliest sample in the low bits; crossed: channel disabled.
DEVICE_CODE and ENABLE are register fields of the IPs; sample_slots_select is the log2 of the slots per sample, a signal from IP A.
sample_slots_select switches only in builds with ENABLE_20BIT and a 16 or 14 bit depth; in the other builds the slot size is fixed by the build, as shown.
Sampling alignment of the two converters is not implemented.
Use the same filter and decimation settings on both converters: with different rates the slower one sets the rate and samples of the other side are skipped.
the settings of an example: register fields of the IPs and sample_slots_select
